text: あんまり　みないほうが　いい　みたいだ…

structure.jp: あんまり　みないほうが　いい
structure.en: it's better not to look too much

patterns.name: 〜ないほうがいい
patterns.span: みないほうが　いい
patterns.explanation: A 'not' verb followed by ほうが　いい says that not doing it is the better choice. みないほうが　いい = 'it's better not to look'.

patterns.name: 〜みたいだ
patterns.explanation: みたいだ at the end says 'it seems that', a guess from what you can see. みないほうが　いい　みたいだ = 'it seems better not to look'.

patterns.name: あまり〜ない
patterns.explanation: あまり with a 'not' verb means 'not very much'. あんまり is a casual way to say it. あんまり　みない = 'not look too much'.
